Fionnuala highlights the convenience of the Control Center's audio settings adjustment by mentioning that it allows users to modify audio settings without interrupting the game experience. This feature is particularly appreciated during intense moments in gameplay, as it enables players to fine-tune their audio experience seamlessly. Fionnuala's sentiment emphasizes the user-friendly nature of the Control Center and its contribution to an immersive and uninterrupted gaming session.

Fionnuala shares her positive experience with the Control Center, specifically praising its ability to adjust audio settings on the fly. She notes that this functionality significantly enhances gameplay, especially during critical moments, by avoiding the need to pause the game. This convenience is a testament to the thoughtfully designed user interface that prioritizes player comfort and immersion, ensuring that players can quickly adapt their audio experience without the inconvenience of halting their progress.
